name: How long does a typical exterior moisture protection project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical exterior moisture protection project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of an exterior moisture protection project varies widely based on the scope and complexity. Small repairs like sealing a few cracks might take a day or two. More extensive projects, such as replacing significant sections of siding with new moisture barriers, upgrading flashing throughout the home, or addressing foundation waterproofing, could range from several days to a few weeks. We provide a detailed timeline after our initial assessment, considering factors like weather and material availability.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project duration varies by scope; small repairs might take days, while extensive work could take weeks. We provide a timeline after assessment.
